                    v333.Name.Visible = false
                    v333.DistanceText.Visible = false
                    v333.HealthBarBG.Visible = false
                    v333.HealthBar.Visible = false
                    v333.Tracer.Visible = false

                    return
                end

                local v334 = v27(k)

                if v334 > t3.value15.ESP.MaxDistance then
                    local v335 = v252

                    if not v335 then
                        return
                    end

                    v335.Box.Visible = false
                    v335.BoxOutline.Visible = false
                    v335.Name.Visible = false
                    v335.DistanceText.Visible = false
                    v335.HealthBarBG.Visible = false
                    v335.HealthBar.Visible = false
                    v335.Tracer.Visible = false

                    return
                end

                local Character = k.Character
                local v337

                if not Character then
                    v337 = nil
                else
                    v337 = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if not v337 then
                        v337 = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Character.PrimaryPart
                    end
                end

                local v338 = not v337
                local v339 = if Character then Character:FindFirstChild("Head") else nil
                local v340 = v24(Character)

                if not v338 then
                    v338 = not v339 or not v340
                end

                if v338 then
                    local v341 = v252

                    if not v341 then
                        return
                    end

                    v341.Box.Visible = false
                    v341.BoxOutline.Visible = false
                    v341.Name.Visible = false
                    v341.DistanceText.Visible = false
                    v341.HealthBarBG.Visible = false
                    v341.HealthBar.Visible = false
                    v341.Tracer.Visible = false

                    return
                end

                local v342, v343 = t3.value5:WorldToViewportPoint(v337.Position)

                if not v343 or v342.Z <= 0 then
                    local v344 = v252

                    if not v344 then
                        return
                    end

                    v344.Box.Visible = false
                    v344.BoxOutline.Visible = false
                    v344.Name.Visible = false
                    v344.DistanceText.Visible = false
                    v344.HealthBarBG.Visible = false
                    v344.HealthBar.Visible = false
                    v344.Tracer.Visible = false

                    return
                end

                local v345 = t3.value5:WorldToViewportPoint(v339.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                local v346 = t3.value5:WorldToViewportPoint(v337.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                local v347 = math.abs(v345.Y - v346.Y)
                local v348 = v347 * 0.5
                local v349 = v342.X - v348 / 2
                local v350 = v342.Y - v347 / 2

                if t3.value15.ESP.Boxes then
                    v252.BoxOutline.Size = Vector2.new(v348, v347)
                    v252.BoxOutline.Position = Vector2.new(v349, v350)
                    v252.BoxOutline.Visible = true
                    v252.Box.Size = Vector2.new(v348, v347)
                    v252.Box.Position = Vector2.new(v349, v350)
                    v252.Box.Visible = true
                else
                    v252.Box.Visible = false
                    v252.BoxOutline.Visible = false
                end

                if t3.value15.ESP.Names then
                    v252.Name.Text = k.DisplayName
                    v252.Name.Position = Vector2.new(v342.X, v345.Y - 20)
                    v252.Name.Visible = true
                else
                    v252.Name.Visible = false
                end

                if t3.value15.ESP.Distance then
                    v252.DistanceText.Text = string.format("[%dm]", (math.floor(v334)))
                    v252.DistanceText.Position = Vector2.new(v342.X, v346.Y + 5)
                    v252.DistanceText.Visible = true
                else
                    v252.DistanceText.Visible = false
                end

                if t3.value15.ESP.Health then
                    local v351 = math.clamp(v340.Health / v340.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                    local v352 = v252
                    local v353 = v349 - 4 - 4

                    v352.HealthBarBG.Size = Vector2.new(4, v347)
                    v252.HealthBarBG.Position = Vector2.new(v353, v350)
                    v252.HealthBarBG.Visible = true

                    local v354 = v347 * v351

                    v252.HealthBar.Size = Vector2.new(4, v354)
                    v252.HealthBar.Position = Vector2.new(v353, v350 + v347 - v354)
                    v252.HealthBar.Visible = true

                    if v351 > 0.6 then
                        v252.HealthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                    elseif v351 > 0.3 then
                        v252.HealthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                    else
                        v252.HealthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                    end
                else
                    v252.HealthBarBG.Visible = false
                    v252.HealthBar.Visible = false
                end

                if t3.value15.ESP.Tracers then
                    v252.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(t3.value5.ViewportSize.X / 2, t3.value5.ViewportSize.Y)
                    v252.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(v346.X, v346.Y)
                    v252.Tracer.Visible = true

                    return
                end

                v252.Tracer.Visible = false
            end)
        end
    end
